field.label: Sub-tick release
field.help: Shape with dummynet-st: dummynet with CAKE built in, which releases packets between clock ticks rather than a tick's worth at a time, so they wait less and leave in smaller bursts. Off: the stock dummynet and dn_cake.ko. The stock dummynet is used anyway when dummynet-st does not match the kernel.

field.label: Release interval (us)
field.help: The longest a packet waits for release once the pipe's rate lets it go, in microseconds. Lower releases more often, at more CPU cost on a router short of it; the clock tick (1000 at kern.hz=1000) or more releases once per tick, as the stock dummynet. Applies to every shaper pipe, not only the CAKE ones.
